purpose: Retained-data reporting only; replaces the earlier five-map display recipe additively after Q clearance. No scientific fitness or physical value is recomputed.

membership.policy: iterate_all52_roster_metadata_rows; only four proposed canonical response channels provide normalized spatial values; all other rows remain missing with explicit reason
membership.geometry_thickness: excluded; te is geometry and th is a distinct unregistered grid
membership.scientific_weighted_fitness: separate original contracts; no weighted fitness vector, pass-count score, or Individual2002 vector enters this display

registration.association: one serialized coefficient per original triangle at the same source index
registration.validation: Refuse identity/hash, field-length, node/cell-index, association or declared-domain mismatch. No implicit domain conversion.
registration.cross_mesh_refined_solid_or_foreign_subj: not admitted; contribution null with reason

lat.quantity: DKT unit lateral-load bending surface von Mises corner maximum
lat.mask: none; every finite serialized zero remains valid

pry.quantity: T6 unit in-plane tip-load centroid von Mises response
pry.mask: none; every finite serialized zero remains valid

ring.quantity: T6 unit ring-traction resultant centroid von Mises after source seated-region zeroing

mask.rule: triangle centroid x >= 76 + retained genome grip_dx - 3 mm; derive only from original source mesh/genome
mask.rounding: Serialized coordinate half-quantum0.0005mm. Refuse ambiguous zero-valued boundary cells. A positive stored ring value proves the single ambiguous original cell is active; do not generalize value>0 into a validity predicate.
mask.runtime_source: derive from retained source and validate against admitted mask fingerprint, not a mutable generated-file dependency

twist.quantity: DKT unit chord-torque bending surface von Mises corner maximum before global envelope torsion correction
twist.mask: none; source capacity exclusion is not a mask for this raw response display

typed_missingness.valid: finite scalar with source-domain association and no explicit source mask
typed_missingness.missing: Option::None / JSONnull plus declared reason: unavailable, scalar_only, excluded_dependent, excluded_geometry, incompatible_domain, masked_by_source, zero_area
typed_missingness.corrupt: Nonfinite number, untyped value, unexpected absent key, invalid association or malformed registration => error. JSONNaN/Infinity prohibited.
typed_missingness.genuine_finite_zero: valid unless original source mask excludes that exact cell
typed_missingness.all_missing_test: retained in roster; no numerical effect on cell mean

normalization.name: area_weighted_pooled_tie_midrank_v1
normalization.input: original finite registered unit-response values and positive source-triangle areas; apply only explicit source masks
normalization.weight: absolute signed-cross-product triangle area in mm2 / 2 from retained original xy
normalization.tie_policy: Group all exactly equal finite serialized values; +0 and -0 are equal; all members of a tie share one rank independent of source order.
normalization.empty_or_zero_total_valid_area: all normalized values missing; no fallback denominator or fabricated zero
normalization.zero_area_cell: retained in source inventory; excluded as missing/zero_area from rank and mean
normalization.raw_values_units_extrema_and_denominator: persist per-channel source hash, original units, valid/masked/missing/zero counts, raw range, valid area and pooled-tie policy

mean.name: unweighted_mean_of_available_normalized_channels_v1
mean.formula: mean_i=sum(finite normalized value for eligible channels valid at cell_i)/number_of_available_channels_i
mean.interpretation: dimensionless display index of relative response locations; high value is not high fitness, safety, likelihood or desirability

coverage.per_cell_count_denominator: 4 eligible registered response channels, never52 metadata rows or44 predicates
coverage.area_denominator: sum positive finite area across all25209 original source triangles before any decorative locator or STL projection
coverage.each_channel_support: valid source-triangle area / whole positive source-mesh area; include excluded/missing counts and reasons separately
coverage.count_area_fractions: for q=0..4, source area of cells with exactly q contributors / whole positive source-mesh area; fractions sum1 within recorded numerical tolerance
coverage.support_panel: visible q=0..4 count key, counts/area fractions, eligible/roster denominator text; never imply uniform support

display_transfer.kind: Display-only transfer from original plate response to retained surface mesh from the same export
display_transfer.source_frame: unposed original XY in mm; exact existing rigid pose only changes final view
display_transfer.assignment: nearest original D1 triangle centroid to retained STL triangle centroid in XY; stable ties by smallest original D1 triangle index; refuse no candidate rather than defaulting to cell0
display_transfer.scope_limit: Surface color visualizes a nearby retained plate response index; it is not a solved volumetric STL stress field.
display_transfer.geometry: Preserve exact retained surface triangles, original silhouette/holes and bounds. No remesh or geometry edits.
display_transfer.surface_lighting: none; flat scalar colors use the identical transfer as numeric key

palette.name: jarambit_navy_teal_yellow_orange_red_v1
palette.interpolation: piecewise linear in sRGB code values; clamp to[0,1], round nonnegative channels to nearest u8
palette.secondary_cues: Numeric ticks, under/over cues when contrast clips, explicit contributor support, grayscale/color-vision review.

display_contrast.predeclared_preview: area-weighted Q05–Q95 of finite available composite values on positive original source area; preview only until Q readability adjudication
display_contrast.quantile_rule: left-continuous weighted inverse CDF: smallest value whose cumulative positive valid area reaches p*total_valid_area; group equal values
display_contrast.preview_transfer: clamp((mean-low)/(high-low),0,1); label numeric low/high in untransformed composite units
display_contrast.constant_or_collapsed_window: common display midpoint0.5; record collapsed window; full[0,1] companion unchanged
display_contrast.tail_receipt: Count and source-area fractions strictly below/above bounds; boundary equalities separate; show saturation cues. Never relabel contrast coordinate as raw index.

comparison: all exact retained visible surface-triangle edges on
mesh_preview.final_choice: Q actual reading-size review; default off when mesh darkens or obscures field

required_review: exact original mask and finite-zero policy
contrast versus raw scalar and scientific fitness separation
